highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 3.119.5 backports Apple SDK 26.0 library TFMs and fixes a WinUI .NET 9 DLL lookup failure.

bullets.lead: Apple SDK 26.0 library TFMs and unversioned app TFMs backported
bullets.detail: Library targets now use versioned TFMs (26.0) while app targets use unversioned ones, matching Apple's current SDK layout. This aligns the 3.119.x line with the fix first shipped in 4.x.

bullets.lead: WinUI Projection DLL not found for .NET 9 consumers fixed
bullets.detail: The WinUI .NET 9 projection path was missing from the NuGet package; it is now correctly included.

contributor_summaries.drasticactions: Backport of Apple SDK 26.0 library and unversioned app TFM fixes to the 3.119.x line
